item.title: Suspect arrested after alleged casino thefts in Port Allen; second suspect wanted
item.description: A Baton Rouge man accused of trying to steal cash from gaming machines at a casino in West Baton Rouge was arrested.

item.title: BRPD Sgt. Caleb Eisworth to be honored in Washington, D.C.: Fundraiser launches for travel costs
item.description: Donations are wanted to cover travel expenses for family members and officers to attend the National Law Enforcement Memorial Wall ceremony in Washington, D.C., where Sgt. Caleb Eisworth's name will be added.

item.title: Body believed to be Lil Jon's missing son found in Georgia: Police
item.description: A body believed to be that of rapper Lil Jon’s missing son has been recovered by search teams in Georgia, according to police.

item.title: Legendary outdoorsman Don Dubuc retires long-running radio show
item.description: After almost 40 years, the king of the outdoors, Don Dubuc is ending his long-running radio show, "The Outdoors with Don Dubuc" on WWL radio.

item.title: Louisiana ACLU calls for transparency after Angola inmate dies
item.description: The ACLU of Louisiana demands transparency, including the release of video footage, as the death of an Angola Prison inmate is being investigated.

item.title: Autopsy shows severe injuries in Baton Rouge toddler's death; trial ongoing
item.description: Lanaya Cardwell took the stand in her own defense Friday during her trial for the death of her 2-year-old daughter, Nevaeh Allen. Cardwell is currently facing a charge of second-degree cruelty to a juvenile.

item.title: Former West Baton Rouge deputy arrested, accused of having relationship with minor
item.description: A former West Baton Rouge Parish Sheriff's Office deputy was arrested after being accused of having a relationship with a juvenile.

item.title: No one saw it coming: LSUS’s historic 65‑game run is finally broken
item.description: The LSU Shreveport Pilots baseball team's 65-game winning streak was snapped by the Central Methodist Eagles in a 4-3 loss on Thursday.
